name: HallucInation eLiciTation (HILT)
description: HILT is a publicly available dataset designed to profile hallucination in large language models by categorizing hallucinations based on degree, orientation, and type. It contains 75,000 samples generated using 15 contemporary LLMs with human annotations, enabling quantification and comparative evaluation of hallucination vulnerability in LLMs.
reputation: A publicly available hallucination profiling dataset that has seen some use in hallucination analysis, but it is not yet a broadly standardized benchmark.
notes: Includes a fine-grained categorization of hallucination types and degrees; also proposes a Hallucination Vulnerability Index (HVI) for ranking LLMs.
